chapter: With Chick Webb and Ella Fitzgerald, 1936-39
title: Boston engagement at La Vodges with Artie Shaw's band
summary: Chick's band broke records at a Boston eatery while Artie Shaw's band played nearby, where McRae started writing for Shaw.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: That was like when Artie Shaw was there (and I (inaudible)) started writing with Artie. I think it was in '37 or '38. Working for (inaudible) both bands. Artie went to Boston and Chick Webb was in Boston, (inaudible) LaVodges.
LaVodges. It's like a eatery. It's like one of the classy places everybody go to eat.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

They had a couple of places there.
And they had been losing business with the big
white bands, so they decided to bring in the colored
bands, you know.

And we went there and broke all records.
And Artie Shaw came up a week later to the Roseland.
We was there for about four or five -- a couple of
months together, you know.

Because that was the time that Artie
said he wanted me to do some things with him, because
he was going coast to coast from Back Bay (inaudible). I say, "Oh,
yeah. I'll write you something" --
